analysis.service: Fixed8-byte frame,3-byte parser candidate; constant work per byte, fixed memory, no allocation. Encode CRC16bit-steps plus nibble conversion.
analysis.posted: Bounded8-entry queue; each flush O(k),k<=8; irreversible prefix and quarantine metadata are part of the contract.
analysis.comparison: Same preconfigured8N1 single-byte TXE/write/TC contract with fresh per-call context. HAL handle initialization and original PlBytePort construction both charged. Persistent-handle amortization is a different experiment.
analysis.maintenance: Literal G4 adapter changes status/data indices to7/10; generated approach updates schema/selection and regenerates; vendor approach changes pinned implementation/device headers/config and audits the additional BUSY_TX abort check. Equal selected traces do not imply concurrent-abort equivalence.

limits: Local frames are not maximum call-chain/IRQ stack. Guest harness code is separate from these three GC-linked cost images.
No physical latency/bandwidth or CPU cycle timing inferred.
Unused object functions may appear in .su listings; retained symbol maps identify selected runtime closure.
